D: A struggling London actress working as an elf in a year-round Christmas shop meets someone who changes everything.
P: Serve the sweets when Kate clocks on at the Christmas shop.
S: Grilled sausages in soft rolls with fried onions and mustard, a London Christmas market favourite.
Warm little mince pies dusted with icing sugar, with a dollop of cream on the side.
M: Kate's family from the former Yugoslavia
Capsicums stuffed with beef and rice and baked in tomato sauce, Eastern European home cooking at the family table.
W: Gingerbread biscuits with white icing, the kind of thing sold all year in Santa's shop.
K: Warm spiced red wine with orange, spiced apple juice for anyone not drinking.

s.how: Grill 8 beef sausages for 12 minutes, turning. Fry 2 sliced onions in oil until soft and golden. Serve in 8 bread rolls with the onions and English mustard.
Warm 12 mince pies at 160C for 10 minutes. Dust with icing sugar and serve with 300ml whipped cream on the side. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Kate's family from the former Yugoslavia
m.how: Mix 500g beef mince with 150g cooked rice, a diced onion and paprika. Fill 6 hollowed capsicums, stand them in a dish with 700g passata and bake covered at 180C for 50 minutes.

w.how: Melt 100g butter with 100g golden syrup and 80g brown sugar. Mix in 300g flour and 2 tsp ginger, roll out, cut shapes and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Ice once cool.

d.how: Heat 750ml red wine with orange slices, 2 cinnamon sticks and 3 tbsp sugar for 15 minutes without boiling. Heat apple juice the same way for anyone not drinking.
